title: Critical Citrix NetScaler Flaw Allows Attackers to Bypass Authentication
content_md: Cloud Software Group has issued a critical security bulletin regarding two vulnerabilities that affect customer-managed NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway appliances. Among these, there is an authentication-bypass flaw that could expose remote-access environments to unauthenticated breaches.
